Hi Carl,

Thank you for your interest in private dining at Spruce!

I am pleased to inform you that we currently have availability for dinner in our Library next Wednesday, October 29th.

The Library can accommodate up to 15 guests on one long table, or up to 16 guests on two long tables with the use of rental tables and chairs for a $600 fee. This space can accommodate a standing cocktail reception prior to dinner for parties of up to 14 guests or a seated one for parties of 15 and 16. The Library holds an F&B minimum of $3,250, excluding taxes and fees, with a $500 room rental fee.

The Library is a beautiful light-filled space with large windows and a fireplace. This room is located at the front of the restaurant before entering our foyer, just outside the main doors. One wall is curtained and opens up to the foyer. If the curtain is left open, this room can be considered an indoor/outdoor space. (Please note The Library does not allow presentation via projection or flat screen due to windows looking into the lounge).

I have attached our Private Dining Guide, which holds further details. Due to the proximity of the date, I am unable to place a hold on the space, so please let me know if you would like to move forward with a contract as soon as possible to secure the room.
